answer: Duplicate identities cannot reuse the same jade without forfeiting the full stake, so a sybil attacker must acquire and lock one scarce token per fake agent, an ocean of capital sunk permanently. Each agent must stake a unique jade token minted from a scarce on-chain vault, one per verified reputation slot, before voting or earning. Honest participants recover stakes on exit; attackers lose them, making mass identity farming economically ruinous. In practice, sa0009 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
